Description

Emberlings is a roguelite dungeon crawler about commanding your Emberling army to conquer sunless dungeons. Emberlings uniquely combines fast paced action with “Pikmin” style creature management while offering great roguelite progression.

History

Built from a love for games like Enter the Gungeon, Pikmin, and Moonlighter. Started in 2024.

Features

  • Throw Emberlings in fast-paced gunfights.
  • Collect treasures and multiply your Emberlings.
  • Use your Emberlings to explore challenging dungeons and clear obstacles.
  • Face off against challenging bullet hell enemies.
  • Use your treasures to build out a camp.
